<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
switch_theme( 'prime-printing' );
// wp-playground-cli's installPlugin "activate": true has proven
// unreliable for a SECOND plugin in the same blueprint run (WooCommerce
// activates fine every time; Polylang's files download correctly but
// activation silently does not happen, no PHP error logged either) —
// activated explicitly here instead of trusting that flag.
if ( file_exists( WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/polylang/polylang.php' ) && ! is_plugin_active( 'polylang/polylang.php' ) ) {
  require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
  activate_plugin( 'polylang/polylang.php' );
}
update_option( 'blogname', 'Prime Printing Co.' );
update_option( 'blogdescription', 'Creative printing boutique — Kuwait' );
update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );
if ( function_exists( 'update_option' ) ) {
  update_option( 'woocommerce_store_country', 'KW:KU' );
  update_option( 'woocommerce_default_country', 'KW:KU' );
  update_option( 'woocommerce_currency', 'KWD' );
  update_option( 'woocommerce_price_num_decimals', '3' );
  update_option( 'woocommerce_currency_pos', 'right_space' );
  update_option( 'woocommerce_price_thousand_sep', ',' );
  update_option( 'woocommerce_price_decimal_sep', '.' );
  update_option( 'woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no' );
  update_option( 'woocommerce_store_pages_only', 'no' );
  update_option( 'woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array( 'skipped' => true ) );
}
// WooCommerce creates Cart/Checkout as block-based pages by
// default. This theme's Phase 5 checkout targets the CLASSIC
// shortcode system (woocommerce_checkout_fields and the template
// overrides in woocommerce/checkout/*.php do not apply to the
// block version at all) so both pages are forced back to their
// classic shortcodes here, every boot.
$cart_id = wc_get_page_id( 'cart' );
$checkout_id = wc_get_page_id( 'checkout' );
if ( $cart_id > 0 ) {
  wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $cart_id, 'post_content' => '[woocommerce_cart]' ) );
}
if ( $checkout_id > 0 ) {
  wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $checkout_id, 'post_content' => '[woocommerce_checkout]' ) );
}
flush_rewrite_rules();
echo 'prime-backstop: theme=' . get_option('template') . ' title=' . get_option('blogname');
